variant: Ultra Developer (open secondary development, Thor-U compute)
name: AGIBOT A3 Ultra Developer
summary: The open developer version of AGIBOT's A3 Ultra bipedal humanoid (173 cm, 56 kg, 51 DOF) with 10-DOF OmniHand dexterous hands, Thor-U compute, lidar, RTK-GPS and self-charging, sold in Germany on request by Bipedal.

germany.statusNote: RBTX (igus) sells the A3 Ultra Developer at 89,000 € excl. VAT with a cart. Bipedal GmbH (Leverkusen) lists it as "Preis auf Anfrage" and "Sofort verfügbar".

specs.label: Total DOF
specs.quote: Freiheitsgrade (Total DoF): 51 aktive Freiheitsgrade für maximale Feinmotorik und Ganzkörpersteuerung

specs.value: Livox Mid-360 lidar, RealSense D457 and D415, GPS, GPS-RTK, UWB

specs.label: Power
specs.value: dual battery packs with autonomous charging

capabilities.sdk: Open developer platform for secondary development (per Bipedal)
notes: Rough ground: Bipedal lists 'All-Terrain Perceptual Walking'; outdoor: GPS-RTK 'für Zentimetergenauigkeit im Freien'. No IP rating is given.
Arm payload and runtime are not on the Bipedal page; the standard A3 Ultra record quotes 5 kg hand payload and about 8 h.
